description: Meta-search across openly licensed images, audio and media.
description_zh: 跨开放许可图片、音频与媒体的聚合搜索。

entries.name: Openverse
entries.description: Search 800M+ Creative Commons images and audio from across the web.
entries.description_zh: 检索全网 8 亿+ 知识共享图片与音频。
entries.notes: Always check the license shown for each individual result.
entries.notes_zh: 以每条结果展示的许可为准。

entries.name: Every Stock Photo
entries.description: Search free photos from many public domain and CC sources.
entries.description_zh: 跨多个公有领域与 CC 图源搜索免费照片。

entries.name: Wikimedia Commons
entries.description: 100M+ freely licensed media files, strong for editorial and historical content.
entries.description_zh: 1 亿+ 自由许可媒体文件，编辑与历史类内容尤其丰富。

entries.name: The Public Domain Review
entries.description: Essays and collections about rediscovered public-domain works.
entries.description_zh: 公有领域作品的策展站点，附背景文章。
entries.notes: A discovery/curation site, not a stock host; check each work.
entries.notes_zh: 属发现/策展站点而非素材托管；请逐件核对作品状态。

entries.name: DPLA
entries.description: Digital Public Library of America: aggregated items from US libraries and museums.
entries.description_zh: 美国数字公共图书馆：聚合全美图书馆与博物馆的藏品。

entries.name: Europeana
entries.description: European cultural heritage: artworks, photos and sounds from 3,000+ institutions.
entries.description_zh: 欧洲文化遗产：3,000+ 机构的艺术品、照片与声音。

entries.name: All The Free Stock
entries.description: Directory of free photos, video, audio, icons, fonts and mockups, each carrying a plain-language licence tag.
entries.description_zh: 免费照片、视频、音频、图标、字体与样机的目录，每条都带通俗许可标签。
entries.notes: States that no listed resource needs a sign-up; each entry carries its own licence tag, so check that tag per asset.
entries.notes_zh: 站点声明所收录资源均无需注册；每条各带许可标签，取用前按标签核对。

entries.name: Stock Up
entries.description: Meta-search across free stock photo sites that have granted it permission; images only.
entries.description_zh: 跨已授权的免费图库站点做聚合搜索，仅图片。
entries.notes: Only includes sites that explicitly gave permission and links back to each; results are photos, not video or audio.
entries.notes_zh: 仅收录明确授权并回链的站点；结果是图片，不含视频与音频。

entries.name: O-DAN
entries.description: Cross-search across free stock photo sites, filtered to results carrying a commercial-use licence.
entries.description_zh: 跨免费图库站点的聚合搜索，结果限定为可商用许可。
entries.notes: Shows only results it judges commercially usable, but the underlying licence still comes from each source site.
entries.notes_zh: 只展示其判定可商用的结果，但实际许可仍由各源站决定。
